c74object.name: lp.julie
c74object.description: lp.julie iterates the complex quadratic map z' = z^2 + c that defines the Julia and Mandelbrot sets. Every bang outputs the next point: the real part on the left, the imaginary part on the right. An orbit that escapes starts again at z0.

objarg.name: z0real
objarg.digest: Real part of the starting point

objarg.name: z0imag
objarg.digest: Imaginary part of the starting point

method.name: float
method.description: In the left inlet: z0.real. In the 2nd inlet: z0.imaginary. In the 3rd inlet: c.real. In the 4th inlet: c.imaginary.

method.name: tattle
method.digest: Print the state of the object to the Max Console (double-click does the same)
method.description: Print the state of the object to the Max Console (double-click does the same).
